title: Tesla Added a Button That Can Cause $25,000 in Damage #shorts

scenes.text: Tesla just added a button that can cause up to twenty-five thousand dollars in damage. On purpose.
It's called Emergency Drive Away. It came after a shooting at a Supercharger station in Idaho.
Plugged in and in danger? Shift into drive, hold the brake, tap activate, and go.
The plug breaks away. Coolant spills from the cable, and your car needs a repair visit.
Tesla says fixing the charger can cost up to twenty-five thousand dollars, and abusing it can mean extra penalties.
And one driver in Austin already triggered it by accident.
Life-saving escape, or expensive mistake? Tell me below. Follow EV Drive.
